value.rationale: The four-vertex cycle is the first exceptional divisible-by-four case with rank-three low-degree cohomology. Its integral D4 root-lattice identification and exact arithmetic obstruction to rational-isotypic splitting are a motivated and reusable structural invariant not derivable from homology ranks or rational character.
